vocabulary.definition: an extremely energetic explosion that occurs in outer space, releasing more energy in a few seconds than our sun does in its entire life
vocabulary.example: A gamma-ray burst could destroy us all.

vocabulary.definition: a very small and incredibly dense star primarily composed of neutrons
vocabulary.example: Gas forms during a supernova or neutron star merger.

vocabulary.definition: made magnetic or attracted by a magnet
vocabulary.example: A black hole surrounded by a magnetized disc of gas.

vocabulary.definition: a rotating column of air extending from a thunderstorm to the ground, often causing damage
vocabulary.example: The gas gets twisted into a magnetic tornado.

vocabulary.definition: to clean or clear something by removing dirt, filth, or unwanted material
vocabulary.example: Energy photons blast across the universe and can scour entire planets of life.

vocabulary.definition: the state or process of being or becoming extinct, no longer in existence
vocabulary.example: A mass extinction devastates life on Earth.
